title: kate-lsp: open, change, and close a document on the server
summary: did_open, did_change, and did_close send the three textDocument notifications. uri_for_path makes a file URI for an absolute path. The window sends did_open when a document with a server opens, did_change for each drained DocumentChange, and did_close when the last view closes.

lane.reason: A Cursor cloud agent codes this packet. The crate is pure Rust, the test runs a fake server over pipes on Linux, and the backlog marks the LSP client CLOUD.

definitions.definition:
/// `file://` URI for an absolute path. A relative path gives None.
pub fn uri_for_path(path: &std::path::Path) -> Option<lsp_types::Uri>
